title: Diabetes and Dietary Supplements: What You Need To Know
publisher: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NIH)
text:
This fact sheet focuses on type 2 diabetes.

For a few dietary supplements, there is weak evidence of a possible benefit.

For most supplements, there isn’t evidence to support a beneficial effect on diabetes or its complications.

It’s very important not to replace medical treatment for diabetes with an unproven health product or practice.
